channel.description: Daily DP Show episodes without C&R or Best Of clips.

item.title: Hour 3 – Numerology, Rick Neuheisel
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes get into some of the numbers behind Week 2 in the NFL, including some betting lines. And former college football HC Rick Neuheisel drops by to weigh in on all the college football action from the weekend.

item.title: Hour 2 – Louis Riddick, Todd Who?
item.description:
Dan checks on the early season NFL MVP favorites and gets a breakdown of Week 2 from Louis Riddick. Plus, an unprecedented battle of Todd’s took place over the weekend and the Danettes consider what it would take to name their baby, “Todd.”

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Football, Football, Football!
item.description:
As usual on a Monday morning, DP and the Danettes recap a busy weekend with college football across the pond and some surprising results from Week 2 of the NFL season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Overshadowed Tuesday, Albert Breer
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes discuss the NFL players who had good weeks on the gridiron and just aren’t getting the love they probably deserve. And NFL insider Albert Breer stops by to break down Week 2 of the NFL now that it’s been completed.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Jameis Winston Pick Machine, Michael Irvin
item.description:
Giants QB Jaxson Dart went down early in last night Monday Night Football game giving backup QB Jameis Winston the opportunity to add to impressive amount of career interceptions. Plus, Hall of Famer Michael Irvin stops by to chat with Dan about his alma mater Miami, Jeremiah Smith, and if he has any beef with people he played against. 

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Rams Roll, Tyler Shough
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes recap last night’s statement victory by the Los Angeles Rams. And fresh off of the Saints' win over the Ravens on Sunday, New Orleans quarterback Tyler Shough joins the show to talk about the progression in his career.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 - Executive Decisions in Colorado
item.description:
Dan & the Danette's talk about Bears third string QB Case Keenum possibly starting against the Eagles, Deion Sanders removing players from Colorado's roster following their blowout loss to Northwestern, thoughts on the Commanders and Giants following injuries to both team's starting QBs, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 - Caught Off Guard, Ross Tucker
item.description:
Dan has more thoughts on Mike McDonald's comments during his interview and if McDonald's comments were never meant to be heard by anyone, Ross Tucker joins the show to give his thoughts on some NFL Week 3 matchups and the Broncos - Seahawks accusations, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 - Mike McDonald v Sean Payton, Chase Daniel
item.description:
Dan Patrick and the Danette's discuss Seahawks head coach Mike McDonald revealing that Broncos head coach Sean Payton accused Seattle of cheating, preview Thursday Night Football between the Packers and the Falcons, former NFL QB and current analyst Chase Daniel joins the show to talk about some Week 3 matchups across the NFL, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Cris Collinsworth, Tough Schedule
item.description:
Sunday Night Football analyst Cris Collinsworth joins the show to talk some NFL, including Patrick Mahomes and Mike Shanahan. Plus, Dan dives deep into the stressful Mississippi Valley State Men’s Basketball schedule and speculates on why they would set themselves up with such a high degree of difficulty.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Theme Songs, DeSean Jackson
item.description:
Fritzy shows off his vocals and knowledge of theme songs from classic TV shows and sports programming. Plus, Delaware State Head Football Coach and former NFL WR, DeSean Jackson drops by and tells DP he’s never lost a race.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Jaxson Dart Officially Done, Mike Macdonald on the Record
item.description:
The NY Giants have officially lost QB Jaxson Dart for the season and DP talks about what next for the G-Men. Plus, Seahawks HC Mike Macdonald shared more than he should have in an interview and is now apologizing.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: New Podcast Alert - The Cutoff Episode 1: We're Talking Baseball!
item.description:
A new podcast series from Dan Patrick Productions, "The Cutoff", is a baseball podcast that will be released weekly throughout the MLB postseason, co-hosted by Dan Gardella and Mario Miranda. For our first episode, Dan G and Mario discuss the remaining MLB playoff races as the season winds down as well as previews the MLB playoffs. Enjoy!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 - Injuries to QBs, Kurt Warner
item.description:
Dan & the Danette's talk about some line moves and injury updates in the NFL ahead of Week 3, Hall of Fame QB and NFL analyst Kurt Warner joins the show to talk about the injuries to Jayden Daniels and Caleb Williams, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 - Big Game Bijan, Rob Gronkowski
item.description:
Dan Patrick discusses Bijan Robinson's huge game on Thursday night against the Packers, previewing some of the big college games this weekend, asking who Peyton Manning roots for this weekend between Texas and Tennessee, former Patriots & Buccaneers TE Rob Gronkowski joins the show, talking about the "Most Must-Win Game of the Weekend", and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 - Boo Birds in Lambeau
item.description:
Dan Patrick & the Danette's talk about the Falcons huge win over the Packers on Thursday Night Football, Packers fans booing the team and TE Tucker Kraft taking issue with it, helping Dan understand a Double Trap bet, thoughts on Pete Crow-Armstrong's 40/40 season, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – David Pollack, 2027 NFL Mock Draft
item.description:
Dan & the Danette’s ponder which undefeated NFL team they believe in the least outside of the Raiders, David Pollack joins the show to talk about Arch Manning at Texas so far this year and his thoughts on the hit Oregon QB Dante Moore took, a look at an early 2027 NFL mock draft, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Herm Edwards
item.description:
Dan has more Week 3 thoughts, as the Giants lose pass rusher Brian Burns to a torn ACL and the Minnesota Vikings are somehow 3-0, former NFL HC and analyst Herm Edwards joins the show, a deep dive on the current cast of Sesame Street, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – NFL Week 3, Dante Moore
item.description:
Dan Patrick & the Danette’s give their takeaways on Week 3 of the NFL, with the Ravens outlasting Dallas in Brazil, the big hit from USC DB Desman Stephens that knocked out Oregon QB Dante Moore and Stephens antics afterwards that drew the ire of Oregon HC Dan Lanning, thoughts on Iowa’s game winning drive against Michigan and the student radio call of the game winning TD, the play of the day, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: The Cutoff Episode 2: Wild Card Preview
item.description:
Dan G and Mario preview the MLB Wild Card as well as make their predictions for each series.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – MLB ABS Postmortem, Hijacking Songs
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes consider the success of the new ABS system after the first complete season of its use. And they get sidetracked by a discussion of songs that get hijacked by commercials or significant events.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Josh Allen Rushing TD King, Joey Votto
item.description:
Dan is amazed by Josh Allen’s prolific rushing TD count and thinks he may be the best dual-threat QB to ever play. And former MLB legend Joey Votto drops by as the MLB Wildcard games get underway today.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – MNF Reaction, Chris “Mad Dog” Russo
item.description:
Dan isn’t convinced Case Keenum is the answer in Chicago despite leading the Bears to a big win last night, and he wonders what’s wrong with the Eagles. Plus, good friend Chris “Mad Dog” Russo drops by to chop it up with DP.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Innovative Medical Treatment, Jacob Misiorowski
item.description:
Dan details his experiences with physicians over the years and some of the innovative treatments he has tried for his rheumatoid condition. Plus, Milwaukee Brewers ace Jacob Misiorowski drops by to chat while he waits to see who they will face in the Divisional Round of the MLB Playoffs.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Odell Beckham Jr. Cut, Devin McCourty
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes weigh in on the career of Odell Beckham Jr. after he was cut from the NY Giants roster. And former NFL standout and current analyst, Devin McCourty stops by to talk some pigskin.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – MLB Wildcard Games, Protect College Sports Act
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes react to the opening of the MLB Playoffs yesterday. Plus, they get into the details of the Protect College Sports Act that was recently passed by the US Senate.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Patriots Struggling, Joe Thomas
item.description:
Things get sour in Boston as the New England Patriots struggle at the quarterback position with Drake Maye, and head coach Mike Vrabel takes questions from the press about it. And Dan talks to Cleveland Browns Pro Football Hall of Famer Joe Thomas about what he’s seeing across the NFL, particularly with the early season success from the Cleveland Browns, and what Deshaun Watson needs to do to win back the fans.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Joey Porter Jr’s Address Change, JJ Watt
item.description:
Dan reacts to the late Wednesday trade with cornerback Joey Porter Jr. traded from Pittsburgh to the Dallas Cowboys as owner Jerry Jones pushes chips in to shore up the defense. Former All-Pro edge rusher and current football analyst JJ Watt joins the show and discusses the NFL as Week 4 looms, troubles stand tall for the Rams and Chargers and the showdown between the Chiefs and Broncos, plus what he’s seen from the Cowboys defense as they add Porter Jr.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Playing Hurt, Bryce Harper Make Up, Harold Reynolds
item.description:
Dan is channeling Michael Jordan’s Flu Game after he passes out giving blood this morning, but he’s powering through. Dan wonders if Phillies star Bryce Harper is in line for the Baseball Hall of Fame and what he could gain from a Phillies World Series title. Former MLB Gold Glove Award winner and MLB Network analyst Harold Reynolds joins Dan to discuss the MLB postseason as the Wild Card round provides fireworks early on, why everyone is still underestimating the Dodgers and the changing attitude about pitchers hitting batters.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: The Cutoff Episode 3: Divine Intervention
item.description:
Dan G and Mario preview Phillies-Braves Game 3 before recapping the rest of the Wild Card Series that have already concluded.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Electric Players, The Big German Comes Through
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes discuss the most electric players in the NFL right now, the kind of guys who you can’t miss when they’re on television. The gambling podcast plays around with shock collars. Callers try to help Dan and the Danettes with German words.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Deshaun Needs to Let It Go, Jason Garrett
item.description:
The Browns take victory over the Steelers, but Dan thinks their quarterback just needs to get the chip off his shoulder and stop trying to make a mess of things with the media. Former Cowboys coach and NBC football analyst Jason Garrett joins Dan to discuss ongoing stories in the NFL, including the clashes between Aaron Rodgers and Mike McCarthy, the struggles of Patriots quarterback Drake Maye, and whether the Chargers can halt their freefall.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Browns Win Again, MLB Wildcard Wrap
item.description:
Dan discusses Thursday Night Football as the Cleveland Browns catch their third win of the year. Cameras and microphones catch a communication breakdown and frustration between Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers and coach Mike McCarthy. The wild card round for baseball wraps up, but Dan wants to see more seats filled and perhaps a daytime World Series game.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
